error[L0103]: a signature says what it returns after `->`, not `=`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/a-signature-without-returns-names-none/program.ldn:1:27
  |
1 | fill: (inout row: [2]u32) =
  |                           ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/a-signature-without-returns-names-none/program.ldn:1:1
  |
1 | fill: (inout row: [2]u32) =
  | ^^^^ declared here
  = note: [1800]: a signature is the parameter list in parentheses, `->` and the returns: write `-> none` before `=` for a routine that returns nothing, or name the returns, as in `-> (code: i32)`
